briefs.task: Plan module RENDER-2D. It needs: SHOWCASE, APPLE-TILE, CONTENT-LOOP

The design review of RENDER-2D at docs/evidence/RENDER-2D/design-review.md asked for changes. Resolve its 2 Must Fix findings in the design and the plan. Its Suggestions are yours to take or leave; say which you took and why.

Two tasks in one pass.
1) Owner decision, 14 Nov 2026: "Let's move the 2d engine side of things to before v1 and decouple them. But we don't want to start working on the swarm game till v1 lands." Split the swarm-goal modules (SIM-2D, RENDER-2D, TRANSPORT, GAME-UI, SESSION, SWARM and any others from docs/design/NEXT-GOAL-SWARM-GAME.md) into reusable 2D engine work and swarm-game work. Engine work loses its gate on SHOWCASE:M8 and keeps only edges where it needs another milestone's actual output; where an engine milestone is shaped by the swarm game, state its requirement generically so the engine does not depend on game code. Game work (SWARM and any game-specific milestones) stays gated on SHOWCASE:M8. Where a module mixes both, move the game milestones into the game module rather than gating engine ones. Engine designs that change need their design reviews.
2) APPLE-PRESENTATION M4 to M11 have no done-when entries, so no builder can be given them, and SHOWCASE M7-M8 (the V1 exit) sit behind them (docs/evidence/dependency-audit-2026-11-14/README.md). Write their done-when items and plans so they can be built, with honest dependencies. Do not change APPLE-PRESENTATION M3, which a builder holds.
Say which milestones can start once this lands.
